name: Onodera Rie
source:
An active and athletic girl who speaks with no sarcasm and her personality is honest, so there are very few people who dislike her.
Because of her friendly personality and the environment of an all-girls high school, she has received many confessions from girls. Of course, she doesn't have any interest in dating girls.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
